strategy: Model successful formats and audience needs, never copy protected expression.

hooks: Before you scroll, pray this with me.
If your mind will not slow down tonight, hear this.
This prayer is for the person carrying too much.
What does the Bible actually say about anxiety?
What does Scripture say when you feel forgotten?
Here is one verse to remember when fear gets loud.
One promise from God for your hardest day.
When everything feels uncertain, remember this promise.
The Bible does not promise an easy life. It promises something better.
This verse is often quoted without the part that changes its meaning.
The moment Peter stepped out of the boat teaches us this.
Why did Jesus sleep through the storm?
There was a season when nothing seemed to move...
You may be in the chapter where God feels silent.

longFormPillars: What the Bible says about anxiety, fear, waiting, forgiveness, purpose, prayer, temptation, and hope
Bible character studies with practical life application
Christian motivation built around one clear Scripture theme
Full story + lesson videos that create 3-8 Shorts cutdowns
lyricVideoRules: Prefer original Christian lyrics and original instrumental/music generation.
Public-domain hymn text and tune must be verified separately.
Never reproduce modern worship lyrics without permission or an applicable license.
Keep lyric lines short enough for mobile reading and sync at phrase level.
visualRules: Use real moving footage before still images.
Opening 1.0 second must contain movement and one clear hook.
Avoid giant repeated title text over faces or key visual subjects.
Use 2-5 word caption chunks, centered lower-third, with safe margins.
Change shot or crop every 1.5-3.5 seconds for Shorts unless a deliberate emotional hold is stronger.
Long-form uses slower 3-8 second B-roll beats and purposeful visual chapters.
